purpose: Source-first design round after Q017-G3 failed its data/PIT contract. Identify three free, public, independently timestampable information mechanisms without any performance evaluation.

fixed_validation_universe.name: q018_official_event_source_validation
fixed_validation_universe.selection_rule: Fixed ex-ante design universe; no selection by return, holdout, or coverage outcome.

candidates.mechanism: Publicly disclosed insider purchase/sale activity can carry issuer-specific information distinct from price trend and portfolio risk controls.
candidates.fixed_signal_rule: For each issuer-day, signed transaction-count imbalance in Form 4 Table I: P=+1 per row, S=-1 per row; all other transaction codes excluded. No weighting or threshold search.
candidates.point_in_time: Use EDGAR ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME of the filing as the information-availability timestamp; act no earlier than the next eligible trading bar.
candidates.coverage_contract: Complete issuer-to-CIK mapping and Form 4 filing coverage for the fixed universe and study window; amendment and duplicate handling must be deterministic before formalization.
candidates.cost_contract: SEC public EDGAR only; no paid insider-data vendor.

candidates.source: Federal Reserve official FOMC statements and meeting records
candidates.mechanism: Changes in the target federal-funds-rate decision are a distinct monetary-policy information event rather than a price-derived signal.
candidates.fixed_signal_rule: Per scheduled FOMC decision, signal is +1 for an increase in the target-rate range midpoint, -1 for a decrease, 0 for unchanged. No NLP, threshold, or parameter search.
candidates.point_in_time: Use the official statement/release date as the public-information date and act no earlier than the next eligible trading bar.
candidates.coverage_contract: Complete fixed-window FOMC decision/event coverage with deterministic release-date mapping; historical gaps cause DATA_INSUFFICIENT.
candidates.cost_contract: Federal Reserve public website only; no paid macro feed.

candidates.source: U.S. Treasury / TreasuryDirect official auction-result releases
candidates.mechanism: Auction demand conditions can reveal changes in marginal sovereign-duration demand distinct from equity price trend and portfolio-volatility controls.
candidates.fixed_signal_rule: For each fixed 10-year Treasury note auction, use the signed change in bid-to-cover ratio versus the immediately preceding 10-year auction: positive=+1, negative=-1, unchanged=0. No threshold search.
candidates.point_in_time: Use the official auction-result publication date and act no earlier than the next eligible trading bar, avoiding dependence on an uncertain intraday publication timestamp.
candidates.coverage_contract: Complete 10-year note auction-result coverage, including bid-to-cover and publication date, over the fixed study window; missing dates or unverifiable metadata cause DATA_INSUFFICIENT.
candidates.cost_contract: TreasuryDirect / U.S. Treasury public releases only; no paid rates/auction feed.

source_feasibility_rules.minimum_evidence_before_formalization: A candidate must first pass deterministic source coverage, point-in-time availability, reproducible parsing, and provenance checks.
source_feasibility_rules.failure_action: DATA_INSUFFICIENT; do not modify the fixed candidate to rescue coverage.
source_feasibility_rules.formalization_rule: Only a fixed candidate whose source contract passes may receive a separate performance preregistration. Source feasibility success does not imply performance support.

interpretation: Design material only. Candidates are intentionally unranked and no performance conclusion is implied.
